top_signals.title: Kylian Mbappé faces China backlash as sponsors cut ties over viral meme
top_signals.summary: Chinese state media has warned Kylian Mbappé that his apology over remarks referring to Mao Zedong as a dictator will be judged against his actions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Rights monitors raise concerns over UAE diplomat’s bid for next U.N. boss
top_signals.summary: Pushback against Lana Nusseibeh, the UAE's former ambassador to the U.N., has gathered steam since her late entry into the race last week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
